<style>
.sc-lesson{--c-main:#1f5fbf;--c-soft:#e8f0fc;--c-why:#fff4e0;--c-why-b:#e8a317;--c-ev:#e9f6ee;--c-ev-b:#2e9e5b;--c-key:#fde9ec;--c-key-b:#d6455d;line-height:1.95;font-size:calc(1em + 2pt)}
.sc-lesson figcaption,.sc-lesson .sc-sources{font-size:calc(1em - 2pt)}
.sc-lesson .sc-box{border-radius:10px;padding:12px 16px;margin:1.2em 0;border-left:6px solid;color:#1b2430}
.sc-lesson .sc-box b.t{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:.5em;margin-bottom:4px}
.sc-lesson .sc-box b.t::before{content:"?";flex:none;width:1.6em;height:1.6em;border-radius:50%;background:var(--c-why-b);color:#fff;font-weight:800;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font-size:.9em}
.sc-lesson .sc-ev b.t::before{content:"✓";background:var(--c-ev-b)}
.sc-lesson .sc-num b.t::before{content:"＝";background:#5a4fcf}
.sc-lesson .sc-key b.t::before{content:"!";background:var(--c-key-b)}
.sc-lesson .sc-why{background:var(--c-why);border-color:var(--c-why-b)}
.sc-lesson .sc-ev{background:var(--c-ev);border-color:var(--c-ev-b)}
.sc-lesson mark.sc-exam{background:linear-gradient(transparent 15%,#ffe14d 15%,#ffe14d 90%,transparent 90%);color:#1b2430;padding:0 .1em;border-radius:2px}
.sc-lesson .sc-legend{border:1px dashed #b8a000;border-radius:8px;padding:6px 12px;margin:.8em 0;font-size:.9em}
.sc-lesson .sc-num{background:#eef0fb;border-color:#5a4fcf}
.sc-lesson .sc-key{background:var(--c-key);border-color:var(--c-key-b)}
.sc-lesson .sc-box p{margin:.3em 0}
.sc-lesson figure{margin:1.2em 0;text-align:center;background:#fff;border-radius:10px;padding:10px}
.sc-lesson figure svg{max-width:100%;height:auto}
.sc-lesson figcaption{font-size:.85em;color:#5b6877}
.sc-lesson .semicon-hook{background:var(--c-soft);border-radius:10px;padding:4px 16px;color:#1b2430}
.sc-lesson h2{border-left:8px solid var(--c-main);padding-left:.6em}
.sc-lesson details.semicon-quiz{border:2px solid var(--c-main);border-radius:10px;padding:8px 14px;margin:1em 0}
.sc-lesson details.semicon-quiz summary{cursor:pointer;font-weight:700;color:var(--c-main)}
.sc-lesson .sc-sources{font-size:.9em}
.sc-lesson .sc-head{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:14px;background:#12634f;color:#fff;border-radius:12px;padding:10px 14px;margin:0 0 14px;line-height:1.35}
.sc-lesson .sc-head-ico{flex:none;width:56px;height:56px}.sc-lesson .sc-head-ico svg{width:56px;height:56px;display:block}
.sc-lesson .sc-head-txt{display:flex;flex-direction:column}.sc-lesson .sc-head-txt b{font-size:1.25em;color:#fff}
.sc-lesson .sc-head-sub{font-size:.7em;color:#e8a317;font-weight:700}.sc-lesson .sc-head-lv{font-size:.95em;color:#e3f1ec}
.entry-title,.sc-lesson h1{text-wrap:balance;line-break:strict;overflow-wrap:anywhere;line-height:1.45}
</style>

<script>
(function () {
  var SB = window.supabase.createClient(
    'https://vpqbkvolturanicmgjmv.supabase.co',
    'sb_publishable_AIzx9T0YHFUN7Z2cpRhSzg_R7zq_gUr'
  );
  var parts = location.pathname.split('/').filter(function (x) { return x; });
  var slug = parts[parts.length - 1];
  var box = document.getElementById('sc-read');
  function draw(done) {
    while (box.firstChild) box.removeChild(box.firstChild);
    var card = document.createElement('div');
    card.style.cssText = 'padding:14px;border:1px solid #1a5fb4;border-radius:10px;background:#f5f9ff';
    var msg = document.createElement('p');
    msg.style.cssText = 'margin:0 0 8px;font-weight:bold';
    msg.textContent = done ? 'この講は読了済みです。' : '読み終えたら、学習の記録に残しましょう。';
    var b = document.createElement('button');
    b.style.cssText = 'padding:9px 18px;border:0;border-radius:6px;background:#1a5fb4;color:#fff;font-size:15px;cursor:pointer';
    b.textContent = done ? '読了を取り消す' : '読了にする';
    b.addEventListener('click', function () {
      b.disabled = true;
      var p = done ? SB.from('progress').delete().eq('article_slug', slug) : SB.from('progress').insert({ article_slug: slug });
      p.then(function (r) { if (r.error) { b.disabled = false; msg.textContent = '記録できませんでした。もう一度お試しください。'; } else { draw(!done); } });
    });
    card.appendChild(msg);
    card.appendChild(b);
    box.appendChild(card);
  }
  SB.auth.getSession().then(function (r) {
    if (!r.data.session) return;
    SB.from('progress').select('article_slug').eq('article_slug', slug).then(function (q) {
      draw((q.data ? q.data.length : 0) !== 0);
    });
  });
})();
</script>
